# Feature Map

<!-- generated by: go -C backend run ./cmd/graphcheck featuremap --write -->

The application's feature list: what a user can reach, the entry point that reaches it, and the code behind it.

This file is generated from three places and must never be edited by hand: the feature index at
`verification/skills/verify-graph/features/index.json`, the route table in
`backend/internal/graph/server_app_routes.go`, and the handler declarations under
`backend/internal/graph/`. `go -C backend test ./...` fails when the file no longer matches them,
so a feature cannot be added, renamed or dropped without this map moving with it.
